description: Hyperlocal event discovery and social planning iOS app
notes: Auth migrated from phone/SMS to email-based OTP. Carpooling demoted to future idea.

items.title: Product specification
items.notes: pulse-product-specification.html

items.title: Design system
items.notes: Color palette, typography, spacing, component library — DesignSystem.swift

items.title: All core screens designed and built
Design review / user testing
items.notes: No real users have seen the app yet

items.title: Data models
items.notes: Models.swift — User, Event, Venue, Plan, Message, RSVP, Friendship, TasteProfile, Group, ActivityPost, Carpool and all enums

items.title: APIService — typed async/await HTTP client
items.notes: Covers all endpoints: auth, feed, events, plans, users, groups, activities, carpools

items.title: Local persistence / caching
items.notes: Every launch re-fetches everything. No SwiftData or UserDefaults caching.

items.title: Push notifications (APNs)
items.notes: No APNs integration. No alerts for plan messages, RSVPs, carpool confirmations.

items.title: Onboarding — email → OTP → name → vibes
items.notes: Migrated from phone to email OTP. Dev bypass: any email + code 000000.

items.title: Feed — scrollable cards, RSVP, save, AI reason chip, time filters, infinite scroll
Event Detail — map, RSVP, friend avatars, price
Map tab — event pins, user location
Search / Explore — category filters, trending, text search
Plans list + detail — voting, chat, member status
Profile — saved events, friends list, attended tab
Groups — list, detail, create, join by invite code
Activity Posts / LFG — feed, post card with join/leave, create sheet
Carpool section in Plan Detail — offer ride, request seat
items.notes: Demoted to future idea. UI and API exist but not prioritized.

items.title: Invite friends to plan
items.notes: InviteFriendsSheet with multi-select checklist. Calls POST /plans/{id}/invite.

items.title: Real-time plan chat
items.notes: WebSocket endpoint exists on backend but iOS uses HTTP only. Messages require manual send to appear.

items.title: Friend discovery / add friends UI
items.notes: No way to find or add friends in-app. Friendships only exist via seed data.

items.title: Profile photo upload
items.notes: avatar_url field exists but no upload UI or storage backend.

items.title: Carpool driver approval UI
items.notes: Future idea — deferred with carpooling feature.

items.title: Group-scoped events
items.notes: group_id exists on Event model but no UI to create or view group-only events.

items.title: Attended events in Profile
items.notes: Backend GET /users/me/attended (past RSVPs with status=going) + ProfileViewModel.fetchAttendedEvents() wired up.

items.title: Settings screen
items.notes: No notification preferences, account deletion, blocked users, etc.

items.title: Error/failure states
items.notes: Most API errors are silently swallowed. No user-facing feedback when actions fail.

items.title: FastAPI app with async SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL + Redis
All database models
items.notes: User, Venue, Event, RSVP, Friendship, TasteProfile, Plan, PlanMember, Message, SavedEvent, Group, GroupMembership, ActivityPost, ActivityParticipant, Carpool, CarpoolPassenger, OTPCode

items.title: Auth — email OTP request/verify, JWT tokens
items.notes: Email-based OTP (migrated from phone/SMS). Dev bypass: code 000000 accepted in debug mode.

items.title: Feed ranking algorithm
items.notes: Cosine similarity (40%) + social score (35%) + temporal decay (15%) + trending (10%)

items.title: All API routers
items.notes: auth, users, events, feed, plans, feedback, groups, activities, carpools

items.title: Docker Compose for local dev
items.notes: postgres + redis + api, one-command startup

items.title: Seed script with Chicago test data
items.notes: Updated to use email-based users. Primary test user: ecarmi@uchicago.edu

items.title: Dev OTP bypass (code 000000)
items.notes: iOS bypasses OTP locally in DEBUG builds. Backend also accepts 000000 in dev.

items.title: Database migrations (Alembic)
items.notes: alembic.ini + env.py (async) + full initial migration 0001_initial_schema.py. Run: cd backend && alembic upgrade head

items.title: Rate limiting
items.notes: OTP endpoint is especially exposed. No slowdown/lockout on repeated attempts.

items.title: Background task queue
items.notes: No Celery/ARQ worker. Things like OTP cleanup, taste profile updates run inline or not at all.

items.title: Redis pub/sub for real-time chat
items.notes: WebSocket uses in-memory dict. Doesn't work across multiple API instances.

items.title: Event ingestion pipeline
items.notes: No real events beyond seed data. Needs Ticketmaster/Eventbrite/etc. integration or admin upload flow.

items.title: Full-text event search
items.notes: Current search is SQL LIKE. No Postgres tsvector or external search engine.

items.title: Taste profile updates from swipes
items.notes: Swipes are recorded in feedback table but taste profile vector is never updated from them.

items.title: Image upload / storage
items.notes: No upload endpoint. No S3/Cloudflare R2 integration.

items.title: Twilio SMS integration
items.notes: Code path exists but Twilio credentials not configured. OTP only prints to console.

items.title: Push notification delivery
items.notes: No APNs/Firebase integration on backend side.

items.title: Admin panel / event moderation
items.notes: No way to manage events, users, or reported content without direct DB access.

items.title: Backend: fix groups.py relationship name
items.notes: Fixed: was using Group.memberships, corrected to Group.members to match model definition.

items.title: Carpooling
items.notes: Model, router, and iOS UI already exist but deprioritized. Driver offers seats, passengers claim them, driver approval flow.

items.title: Real-time plan chat via WebSocket
items.notes: WebSocket endpoint exists on backend (in-memory). Needs Redis pub/sub for multi-instance support and iOS WebSocket client.

items.title: Group-scoped events
items.notes: group_id column exists on Event model. Needs create-event flow + group-filtered feed slice.

items.title: Friend discovery
items.notes: No in-app way to find/add friends. Could use contacts, QR codes, or search by name.

items.title: Backend integration tests against real DB
Cloud deployment (API)
items.notes: Candidates: Railway, Render, Fly.io, AWS ECS

items.title: Managed PostgreSQL
items.notes: Candidates: Supabase, Neon, RDS, Railway

items.title: Managed Redis
items.notes: Candidates: Upstash, Redis Cloud, Railway

items.title: Environment secrets management
items.notes: SECRET_KEY, Twilio creds, etc. currently hardcoded or in docker-compose.yml

items.title: CI/CD pipeline
items.notes: No GitHub Actions. No automated build/test on push.

items.title: Logging / observability
items.notes: No structured logging, no error tracking (Sentry), no metrics.

items.title: iOS staging vs production environments
items.notes: APIService.swift has one hardcoded baseURL pointing to localhost.
